glosses: to date (to note the time or place of writing or executing; to express in an instrument the time of its execution)
to date (to determine the age of something)
to date (to exist from a particular moment)
to date (to exist from a particular moment)

examples.text: Te cenne znaleziska datuje się na wczesny brąz.
